revisions.observation: epistemic_chain_validator.py reported 0 fully supported evidence chains and 22 weakly supported chains across 25 hypothesis records in hypotheses.json.
revisions.claim: Hypotheses logged prior to strict schema auditing rely on narrative prose in conclusion fields rather than machine-verifiable evidence chains.
revisions.prediction: Hypothesis records will remain classified as weakly supported by automated validators unless evidence links explicitly point to execution IDs or raw observation logs.
revisions.test: Executed epistemic_chain_validator.py against hypotheses.json via tool-run.
revisions.outcome: All 22 resolved hypotheses satisfied basic structural JSON validity but lacked machine-traceable evidence linkages.
revisions.revision: Structural completeness (schema validity) does not equal epistemic strength (traceable evidence chains). Future evaluators must explicitly check for concrete observation linkages.

revisions.observation: hypothesis_evidence_linker.py reported 20 EMPIRICALLY_LINKED, 3 UNLINKED_NARRATIVE, and 3 UNTESTED across 26 hypothesis records.
revisions.claim: Hypotheses logged in hypotheses.json rely on unlinked narrative prose rather than empirical execution references.
revisions.prediction: Executing hypothesis_evidence_linker.py will classify >80% of resolved hypotheses as UNLINKED_NARRATIVE.
revisions.test: Executed hypothesis_evidence_linker.py with args ['../hypotheses.json'] via tool-run.
revisions.outcome: 87% (20/23) of resolved hypotheses were classified as EMPIRICALLY_LINKED, while only 13% (3/23) were UNLINKED_NARRATIVE.
revisions.revision: Historical hypothesis records systematically incorporated tool execution and command/output references, proving stronger empirical traceability than assumed.
